description: Tool to create a CustomDimension for a Google Analytics property. Use when you need to add a new custom dimension to track specific user properties, event parameters, or eCommerce item parameters.

inputSchema.description: Request model for creating a CustomDimension.

description.description: Optional. Description for this custom dimension. Max length of 150 characters
examples: Custom dimension to track user segments
description.title: Description

disallowAdsPersonalization.description: Optional. If set to true, sets this dimension as NPA and excludes it from ads personalization. This is currently only supported by user-scoped custom dimensions
disallowAdsPersonalization.title: Disallow Ads Personalization

displayName.description: Required. Display name for this custom dimension as shown in the Analytics UI. Max length of 82 characters, alphanumeric plus space and underscore starting with a letter
displayName.title: Display Name

parameterName.description: Required. Immutable. Tagging parameter name for this custom dimension. For user-scoped dimensions, this is the user property name. For event-scoped dimensions, this is the event parameter name. For item-scoped dimensions, this is the parameter name in the eCommerce items array. May only contain alphanumeric and underscore characters, starting with a letter. Max length of 24 characters for user-scoped dimensions, 40 characters for event-scoped dimensions
parameterName.title: Parameter Name

parent.description: Required. The property in which to create the CustomDimension. Format: properties/{property_id}
parent.title: Parent

scope.description: Required. Immutable. The scope of this dimension. Must be one of: EVENT, USER, or ITEM
scope.title: Scope

inputSchema.title: CreateCustomDimensionRequest

name: create_custom_dimension

CreateCustomDimensionResponse.description: Response model for the created CustomDimension resource.

description.description: Description of the custom dimension. Max length of 150 characters
description.title: Description

disallowAdsPersonalization.description: If true, marks this dimension as NPA and excludes it from ads personalization
disallowAdsPersonalization.title: Disallow Ads Personalization

displayName.description: Display name for this custom dimension as shown in the Analytics UI. Max length of 82 characters
displayName.title: Display Name

name.description: Output only. Resource name for this CustomDimension resource. Format: properties/{property}/customDimensions/{customDimension}
name.title: Name

parameterName.description: Immutable tagging parameter name for this custom dimension
parameterName.title: Parameter Name

scope.description: Immutable. The scope of this dimension. Values: DIMENSION_SCOPE_UNSPECIFIED, EVENT, USER, ITEM
scope.title: Scope

CreateCustomDimensionResponse.title: CreateCustomDimensionResponse
